## Review Summary

This PR implements `validate_metadata()` with 171 tests covering required fields, closed lists, governance policy, the nine-plan standards table, and route agreement. The structure is clean and the no-cascade / no-I/O design is well-executed.

### Critical Finding (blocks merge)

**`_PLAN_ID` regex is too permissive** — `[a-z][a-z0-9-]*` accepts trailing hyphens (`"scope-"`) and consecutive hyphens (`"scope--management"`), both of which are not valid kebab-case. Because the test suite does not include these cases, the defect passes all 171 tests undetected. Two comments have been left with an inline fix for the regex and the missing test parameters.

comments.body:
:stop_sign: **Logic Error**: The `_PLAN_ID` pattern `[a-z][a-z0-9-]*` accepts trailing hyphens (e.g., `"scope-"`, `"a--"`). Since `*` allows zero or more of `[a-z0-9-]`, a string ending in `-` passes `fullmatch`. Valid kebab-case identifiers must not start or end with a hyphen and must not have consecutive hyphens. The regex should be tightened to prevent these malformed plan IDs from silently passing validation.
```suggestion
_PLAN_ID = re.compile(r"[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*", re.ASCII)
```

comments.author: amazon-q-developer[bot]
comments.body:
:stop_sign: **Logic Error**: The dots in `_VERSION` are unescaped regex metacharacters — they match **any character**, not literal `.`. The pattern `[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+` with `fullmatch` would accept `"1X0X0"` or `"100100"` as valid versions. The dots must be escaped with `\.`.
```suggestion
_VERSION = re.compile(r"[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", re.ASCII)
```

comments.body:
## Review Summary

This PR introduces `validate_metadata()` and supporting types/constants for Story 12.2 (ADR-012 plan metadata validation). The structure is clean — pure standard-library module, frozen dataclasses, immutable `MappingProxyType`, and 171 well-organized tests covering all stated acceptance criteria.

### Issues Found

**1. `_PLAN_ID` regex accepts invalid kebab-case (e.g., trailing hyphens) — `lint.py` line 18**
The pattern `[a-z][a-z0-9-]*` with `fullmatch` accepts `"a-"`, `"scope-"`, or `"a--b"` (consecutive/trailing hyphens). True kebab-case must not end with or have consecutive hyphens. A fix is suggested on that line.

**2. Line 19 comment (correction)** — The `_VERSION` pattern using `r"\."` in a raw string is correctly escaped and is _not_ a bug. The `r"..."` prefix preserves the backslash, which the regex engine interprets as a literal dot. Please disregard the comment I placed on line 19.

### Observations (not blocking)
- The `MISSING` sentinel is defined at line 84 _after_ `meta()` at line 74. Python resolves the name at call-time, so this works; however, reordering `MISSING` above `meta()` would make the dependency explicit and is a common convention.
- `adr_rows()` in `TestPlanStandards` slices up to the first ` ``` ` after the table header. If ADR-012 ever gains a fenced code block before the closing of the table block, the parser will silently truncate. This is a fragile coupling between the test and the ADR document format, but it passes under the current document structure.
